title: Israeli Forces Raid Southern Syria Villages, Shell Beit Jinn Outskirts
detail: Israeli military forces entered the village of Bariqa in southern Quneitra near the Israeli border on August 27, 2026, according to Syrian state news agency SANA; an Israeli patrol separately entered Ras al-Ajraf in southern Quneitra countryside and searched homes, while another force raided a home in Taranja, northern Quneitra. Overnight into Thursday, Israeli forces also fired three artillery shells at the Batt al-Warda hill near Beit Jinn in the western Damascus countryside; no casualties or damage were reported. The incidents came days after Mossad chief Roman Gofman met Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani in an attempt to calm tensions following Israel's August 18 airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur airbase.
